credited_answer_job: Select the choice whose argument reproduces the stimulus argument's abstract logical form.
argument_form: Valid two-step conditional chain concluded by contrapositive (if A then B; if B then C; not C; therefore not A) in concrete everyday content; all five choices at uniform topic distance.

trap_plan.mechanism: Same topic flavor and vocabulary rhythm, different underlying form (single conditional plus unrelated observation).
Matches the conclusion type (a negative claim) but premise structure differs (disjunctive elimination, not a chain).
Choice argument is invalid (affirms the consequent) where the stimulus is valid.
Quantifier strength mismatch: replaces the universal chain with a most-chain (permitted weaker slot).

structural_spec.first_principles_d3_frame: d4 parallels in the clean anchor set layer three or more logical steps or mix operator types with subtle validity contrasts among several choices; d3 is one clean chain plus contrapositive, a single operator type, and exactly two near-form competitors.
